derivation: from H44 (אֲבִיעֶזֶר) with the article inserted; father of the Ezrite;
def: an Abiezrite or descendant of Abiezer

occurrences.text: And there came an angel of the Lord, and sat under an oak which was in Ophrah, that pertained unto Joash the Abi–ezrite: and his son Gideon threshed wheat by the winepress, to hide it from the Midianites.
